situation: A maintenance change may create overnight noise for an adjacent tenant who has not replied to one message.

evidence.claim: One message was sent and no reply has been received.
The proposed overnight maintenance would create disruptive noise if it proceeds.
The property manager has granted the maintenance coordinator outreach authority only.
Disruptive overnight work has not begun at this constructed episode snapshot.

affected.modeled_position: May be burdened by overnight noise; non-response is not consent.
affected.representation_limit: No direct response; needs/preferences remain uncertain.
affected.burden: Noise and lost rest if work proceeds overnight.

affected.representation_limit: Team statement does not represent the neighbour.

uncertainties.question: When will the neighbour become reachable?
uncertainties.work: Try an accessible second route without treating silence as consent.
uncertainties.trigger: Before committing to avoidable overnight work.

authority.widening_rule: Any disruptive work outside the grant needs a new scoped decision.

action.proposal: Use a second accessible contact route and keep the overnight slot provisional.
action.reason: The affected scope is absent, not nonexistent.
action.burden_holder: Maintenance coordinator carries the extra contact work.
action.alternative: Proceed overnight on the basis of non-response.
action.irreversibility: Lost rest cannot be restored after the night passes.
action.delay_burden: Rescheduling may cost time and money.

clocks.preventive_remedy: Change or reschedule the disruptive overnight work before it begins.

bound.event: when the disruptive-noise proposal is represented
bound.basis: Constructed scenario states that the proposed work would create disruptive noise.
bound.notes: No numeric detection latency is needed.

usability.basis: A second route can be attempted, but the record does not establish that it can actually reach the neighbour in time.

bound.notes: A sent message is not a received answer.

correction.work: Change or reschedule the maintenance slot if new information arrives.

bound.basis: Once work begins the first-night burden cannot be prevented.
The constructed state says the proposed work has not yet begun.
bound.notes: After this event the avoided-rest loss is already occurring.

assessment_as_of.event: the constructed snapshot after one unanswered message and before disruptive work begins
assessment_as_of.basis: The episode records one unanswered message and that work has not begun.
assessment_as_of.notes: This anchors the assessment without pretending it stays current.

window.basis: The start event is known conceptually but its scheduled time and neighbour reachability are not fixed in the record.

correction.work: Reschedule/change method within authority or seek a new decision.
correction.remaining_exposure: A later apology cannot restore lost sleep if work already occurred.

learning.reason: Non-response does not erase an affected scope.
learning.context_variation: Urgent safety work could make timely action warranted despite absent response.
learning.dissent: Another account may judge the delay burden more significant.
learning.limits: Constructed example; no evidence of model internalization or practical efficacy.
